tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production sprite source for educational YouTube videos. Create a strict3 by3 row-major grid of NINE full-body poses, every cell equal size. Highest native resolution available, transparent RGBA background. Input image1 is the EXACT adopted identity/style reference, not a pixel-edit target. Redraw fresh. The exact adopted Northern Hairy Nosed Wombat shown in image1; identity features: 幅広い毛のある鼻・灰褐色のずんぐり体・丸耳. Preserve the reference’s large head, exact torso LENGTH and WIDTH, short upright two-legged body and two arm-like forepaws. Never shorten/slim the torso or enlarge the head relative to it. Keep exactly the existing2 arms,2 legs and existing tail/horns/ears; do not create a tail on a tailless reference. Preserve its exact eye format when open (white surrounds only if the reference has them, same pupil and no added highlights), facial markings, palette, warm brown contours and subtle paper/watercolor texture. No realistic animal proportions or heavy outline change. All poses keep SAME anatomical head/body scale and proportions as the adopted reference, including every resting/blink/crouch state. Lots of true transparent padding around each complete subject and between cells; no cropped horns/gills/bill/tail/feet. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, ground/shadow, props, sparkles, extra animals or duplicate/disconnected limbs. Required reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom: 1 BLINK: Same exact upright/resting body position, head size, torso length/width, limbs, supports and facing as image1, ONLY the eye(s) gently fully closed as a simple brown lid curve; mouth/expression otherwise unchanged. Do not crouch, nod, shrink or move the body during blink. 2 GREET: Friendly one-forepaw gentle raised greeting, feet planted and head/body scale unchanged. 3 PRESENT_LEFT: Connected forepaw/arm indicates VIEWER LEFT and gaze follows, feet remain planted. 4 PRESENT_RIGHT: Connected forepaw/arm indicates VIEWER RIGHT and gaze follows, feet remain planted. Generate a fresh matching opposite gesture, not a flip-copy. 5 THINK: One existing forepaw gently touches chin, curious head tilt, torso stable. 6 AHA: Small pleased discovery reaction: head perks and one forepaw slightly lifts, friendly eyes; no lightbulb/effect. 7 CHEER: Gentle pleased grounded celebration, two connected forepaws comfortably lifted, smiling closed eyes allowed; no jump or new props. 8 SPECIES_A: Raise both compact forepaws a little toward the chest with a gentle shoulder lift, keeping the short upright mascot torso. 9 SPECIES_B: Relax the shoulders and open the paws slightly outward as a small quiet stretch; both feet stay supported. Species constraint: 全身の大きさをふくらませない。コアラの大きい鼻と丸耳、ウォンバットの幅広鼻、カバの大きい口元、白クマの淡い毛色をそれぞれ維持。 Clean bounded color areas and connected silhouettes; no pigment spills, background haze or extra marks. Do not insert an additional neutral; it is reused from image1.
CRITICAL TRANSPARENCY: true RGBA isolated sprites only. Every pixel outside the separated character silhouettes must have alpha 0, including all gutters and all four canvas corners. Do not paint a beige/white/grey paper rectangle, backdrop, floor, contact shadow, border, diffuse halo, ambient shadow, red/yellow low-alpha colour field or speckles. Watercolour texture must be clipped to the characters themselves. Fresh original drawing, no postprocessing.
